intuition: BST ordering allows a preorder traversal to encode the tree without explicit null markers.

brute_force.approach: Serialize every child pointer with null markers, then rebuild the exact shape using generic binary-tree traversal.

optimal.approach: Store preorder values and reconstruct by attaching each value to the most recent smaller ancestor; unique BST values preserve the original shape.

edge_cases: An empty tree serializes to an empty string.
A one-sided BST must retain the same shape after decoding.
